SELECT /*selectMasterWmStStockList*/ Y.KEP_DEPT, Y.KEP_DEPT_NAME, Y.STOCK_GROUP_TYPE AS GROUP_TYPE, Y.STDCATLG_ID, Y.DESCRIPTION, Y.MAKER_NAME, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, Y.TOT_QTY, Y.ALLOC_QTY, Y.SAFE_STOCK_QTY, Y.STC_SELLER_PRICE, Y.AGENT_NAME, Y.AGENT_TEL, Y.PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, Y.SPECIFICATION, Y.LOCATION_ID, Y.AVAIL_QTY, Y.PRE_GR_QTY, Y.MAX_STOCK_QTY, Y.LAST_REC_DATE, Y.CONTRACT_NO, Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, Y.AGENT , Y.AGENT_NAME || DECODE(Y.AGENT_TEL,'','','('||Y.AGENT_TEL||')') AGENT_VIEW FROM (
SELECT CMS.KEP_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = CMS.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, CMS.STOCK_GROUP_TYPE, STCK.STDCATLG_ID, CQDT.DESCRIPTION, CQDT.MAKER_NAME, STCK.UNIT_MEASURE, STCK.TOT_QTY, STCK.ALLOC_QTY, STCK.SAFE_STOCK_QTY, STCK.STC_SELLER_PRICE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = STCK.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = STCK.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL, DECODE(STCK.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, CQDT.SPECIFICATION, STCK.LOCATION_ID, STCK.AVAIL_QTY, STCK.PRE_GR_QTY, STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY, STCK.LAST_REC_DATE, CQDT.CONTRACT_NO, CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ, STCK.AGENT, STCK.PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSSTCK STCK , ICOMCQDT CQDT, CMSCATLG CMS WHERE STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STCK.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE = CQDT.BUYER AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND STCK.AGENT = 'KRKORE0001' AND STCK.CONTRACT_NO = CQDT.CONTRACT_NO AND STCK.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ AND STCK.PROCESS_TYPE = '1' AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID
AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id} ||'%'
AND STCK.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND CQDT.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND CQDT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%'
AND STCK.LOCATION_ID LIKE '%'||#{st_location_id}||'%'
AND CQDT.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
AND CMS.KEP_DEPT = #{st_dept}
AND CMS.STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = #{st_group_type}
AND STCK.STATUS <> 'D'
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY > 0
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT CMS.KEP_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND CODE = CMS.KEP_DEPT) AS KEP_DEPT_NAME, CMS.STOCK_GROUP_TYPE, STCK.STDCATLG_ID, CQDT.DESCRIPTION, CQDT.MAKER_NAME, STCK.UNIT_MEASURE, STCK.TOT_QTY, STCK.ALLOC_QTY, STCK.SAFE_STOCK_QTY, STCK.STC_SELLER_PRICE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = STCK.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, (SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = STCK.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEL, DECODE(STCK.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TYPE_TEXT, CQDT.SPECIFICATION, STCK.LOCATION_ID, STCK.AVAIL_QTY, STCK.PRE_GR_QTY, STCK.MAX_STOCK_QTY, STCK.LAST_REC_DATE, CQDT.CONTRACT_NO, CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ, STCK.AGENT, STCK.PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSSTCK STCK , ICOMCQDT CQDT, CMSCATLG CMS WHERE STCK.WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STCK.ORG_WAREHOUSE_CODE = CQDT.BUYER AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND STCK.AGENT = CQDT.AGENT AND STCK.CONTRACT_NO = CQDT.CONTRACT_NO AND STCK.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ AND STCK.PROCESS_TYPE = '3' AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID
AND STCK.STDCATLG_ID LIKE '%'||#{st_stdcatlg_id}||'%'
AND STCK.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
AND CQDT.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND CQDT.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%'
AND STCK.LOCATION_ID LIKE '%'||#{st_location_id}||'%'
AND CQDT.MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
AND CMS.KEP_DEPT = #{st_dept}
AND CMS.STOCK_GROUP_TYPE = #{st_group_type}
AND STCK.STATUS <> 'D'
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY > 0
AND STCK.AVAIL_QTY = 0
ORDER BY PROCESS_TYPE, STDCATLG_ID, AGENT, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION
ORDER BY STDCATLG_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, AGENT, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION
ORDER BY AGENT, STDCATLG_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, AGENT, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION
ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, STDCATLG_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, AGENT, SPECIFICATION
ORDER BY SPECIFICATION, STDCATLG_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, AGENT, DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY LOCATION_ID,STDCATLG_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, AGENT, DESCRIPTION,SPECIFICATION
) Y
